scope: Supported visual modes, their context separation and selector contract.
knownLimitations: All colour, typography and layout values are internal proposals derived from MC-04; no value here is a public brand adoption.
Instrument day/sunlight/night modes are software-only specimens. No marine hardware visibility, daylight readability or night-vision performance is claimed: hardware validation remains BLOCKED.

The corporate web-light context keeps the measured MC-04 baseline values; it applies one proposed correction (focusRing) that is NOT applied to the live website, so MC-04 finding F-1 remains OPEN for the public site.
Contrast ratios are computed from declared token values only; they do not model anti-aliasing, glare, night adaptation or real display hardware.

selectorContract.selection: Components inherit custom properties from the nearest <marea-theme> host; no :root or body override exists.

web-light.label: Corporate web (light)
web-light.appliesTo: Isolated corporate web components on the existing light EMBARCARTE visual system. The live site itself is not restyled.

instrument-day.label: Instrument — day
instrument-day.appliesTo: Internal software specimens for bridge daylight use. Not a hardware readability claim.

instrument-sunlight.label: Instrument — sunlight
instrument-sunlight.appliesTo: Internal high-ambient-light software specimen. Glare readability is NOT validated; hardware validation is BLOCKED.

instrument-night.label: Instrument — night
instrument-night.appliesTo: Internal watchkeeping software specimen. Night-vision performance is NOT validated. No #000000 canvas and no #ffffff text.
